findings.current: Unconcealed anger clung heavily to Jin Wikyung’s deeply sunken eyes.
findings.defect: “Deeply sunken eyes” creates a physical description of hollow eye sockets. The Korean describes the subdued depth of Jin Wikyung’s gaze while anger shows through it.
findings.rationale: 깊게 가라앉은 눈동자 describes the emotional quality or depth of his gaze, not physically sunken eyes.
findings.replacement: Unconcealed anger lay heavy in the depths of Jin Wikyung’s eyes.

findings.current: “I know. No—I understand. That is why I ask to be punished.”
findings.defect: The self-correction changes the verb from “know” to “understand,” but the Korean repeats 알고 있다 and instead shifts from familiar to respectful speech toward Jin Wikyung.
findings.rationale: 알고 있네. 아니, 알고 있소 preserves the same proposition while raising the register; a more formal repetition best approximates that shift in English.
findings.replacement: “I know. No—I am well aware. That is why I ask to be punished.”

findings.current: He busted out a new trick right here.
findings.defect: The English explicitly assigns the new trick to Cheongpung, although Mimi is the one who performs the commanded maneuver immediately before this reaction.
findings.rationale: After Cheongpung gives the command, Mimi performs it with 취리리릭; the omitted Korean subject of 신기술을 써 버리네 is therefore the performing snake.
findings.replacement: She busted out a new trick right here.

summary: Faithful overall, with three minor defects involving an emotional description, a register shift, and the performer of a trick.
